note.zh: 在 WorkBuddy（腾讯）默认 Agent 模式下由底层模型一次生成；未加载任何 skill / 插件 / MCP，使用 cases.json 中 beihai-meteorite 的提示词逐字输入、未改写，产出未再修改。Three.js 体素风格程序化 3D 短片，重述《三体》章北海陨石子弹段落：雪林狩猎、三位老航天将领、抬枪、陨石子弹（无迹可寻）、改写道航向；镜头按时间轴剪辑，字幕由结构化清单（含 id/kind/speaker/text/delivery/start/end 七字段）驱动，配 Web Audio 风声与枪声；总时长约 112s（< 360s 上限）。
note.en: Generated in one shot by the underlying model inside WorkBuddy (Tencent)'s default agent mode; no skills, plugins or MCP were loaded, the beihai-meteorite prompt from cases.json was used verbatim and unmodified, and the artifact was not edited afterward. A Three.js voxel-style procedural 3D short film retelling Zhang Beihai's 'meteorite bullet' from The Three-Body Problem: a snowy hunting ground, three elder commanders, the raised rifle, the untraceable meteorite bullet, and the altered course of history; shots are edited on a timeline, subtitles are driven by a structured cue list (the seven fields id/kind/speaker/text/delivery/start/end), with Web Audio wind and gunshot; total runtime ~112s (< 360s cap).
